name: agent-continuity
summary: Provider-neutral coding task continuity across Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
permissions: Read and write its own runtime under ~/.agent-continuity (config, launchers, state, provider skill copies).
Read and merge provider config: ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.codex/hooks.json, ~/.cursor/hooks.json (backed up before change; only Agent Continuity entries are touched).
Run git to read repository/worktree/branch/HEAD/status; never mutates history.
Write continuity files inside the repository: <git-common-dir>/agent-continuity/, a managed block in CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, and .cursor/rules/agent-continuity.mdc.
Query provider-local quota probes (Claude status-line cache, Codex local app-server, Cursor hook fields) without contacting external endpoints or reading credentials.
sideEffects: Creates the ~/.agent-continuity runtime, Node launchers, and per-provider skill copies.
Merges (does not replace) provider hook config and the Claude status line, creating backups first.
Appends/updates a managed continuity block in the repository's CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md and writes .cursor/rules/agent-continuity.mdc.
Spawns git and provider-local processes; performs no reset/clean/stash/rebase/merge/push or worktree deletion.
